# Vendored ft8_lib encoder subset

Source: https://github.com/kgoba/ft8_lib

Upstream commit: `9fec6ca39886edbf96f4f5e71edc76da5074e871`

Only the files required for FT8/FT4 message and tone encoding are retained.
Decoder, demo, test recordings, Python utilities, and FFT support are omitted.
The original MIT license is preserved in `LICENSE` and in
`licenses/ft8_lib/LICENSE`.
